recruiter_program_title: Join the Everest Hiring Program and earn money by recommending workers for warehouse and production jobs across Poland!
recruiter_program_intro: Join the Everest Hiring Program and earn money by recommending workers for warehouse and production jobs across Poland!
recruiter_section_1_text:
You will receive 150 PLN for every worker you recommend, provided that the worker completes 30 calendar days of employment with Everest.

There is no limit to the number of workers you can recommend.
recruiter_list_2_1: Send us the first and last name of the person you want to recommend.
recruiter_list_2_2: The recommended worker must contact Everest and apply for a job independently.
recruiter_list_2_3: We will link the worker to your recruiter profile in our system.
recruiter_list_2_4: Once registered, the referral will be assigned to you.
recruiter_list_3_1: Before receiving your commission, you will sign an electronic cooperation agreement with Everest.
recruiter_list_3_2: You will provide your bank account details for payment or cash payment.
recruiter_list_3_3: Once your recommended worker completes 30 calendar days of employment, you become eligible for the 150 PLN referral commission.
recruiter_list_3_4: Your commission will be paid as a one-time bank transfer after the end of the applicable monthly settlement period.
recruiter_program_footer: Recommend more workers. Earn more money. Grow with Everest!
